notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Fixes, Balance & QoL Improvements
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, and thank you for all the amazing feedback and support during the festival! ❤️[/p][p]I’ve just updated the [b]Agecraft[/b] demo to make the experience smoother and more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔹 What’s new:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several noticeable bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the balance for a smoother start.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra helper elements to improve control and orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a few [b]QoL improvements[/b] - small changes that make the game more comfortable to play.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]✨ What is QoL?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p]“Quality of Life” improvements are little tweaks that don’t change the core gameplay, but make everything feel better. Examples include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]clearer tooltips;[/p][/*][*][p]improved hotkeys;[/p][/*][*][p]quicker access to essential actions;[/p][/*][*][p]better visibility for resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Try out the updated demo and let us know what you think![/p][p]👉 And if you haven’t yet, don’t forget to add [b]Agecraft[/b] to your Wishlist - it really helps a lot 🏗️[/p]
